[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Maximum Side Length of a Square with Sum Less than or Equal to Threshold** [LC 1292 · Maximum Side Length of a Square with Sum Less than or Equal to Threshold](https://leetcode.com/problems/maximum-side-length-of-a-square-with-sum-less-than-or-equal-to-threshold/){difficulty="Medium"}

"Does some square of side $s$ fit?" is a scan of $(m-s+1)(n-s+1)$ squares, each a four-read query once the table exists. Because cells are **non-negative**, if side $s$ does not fit then no larger side does either — so the answer is a monotone predicate, and the search over $s$ can stop at the first failure.

[Solved in full in @sec-pref-p4-b.]{.card-link}
